commands.command: REAL DEFECT #1 (found and fixed): listChildren fails on the root SAF call
commands.summary: First real Import-folder attempt threw android.provider.DocumentsContract$... IllegalArgumentException: 'Invalid URI' inside SafAcquisitionPlugin.listChildren -- DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(parentUri) requires a document URI, but Rust's AndroidSafSource passes the tree URI itself as parentUri for the very first (root) call, which is not a document URI. Fixed in SafAcquisitionPlugin.kt: branch on DocumentsContract.isDocumentUri(activity, parentUri), calling getTreeDocumentId(parentUri) for the tree-URI case and getDocumentId(parentUri) otherwise. Rebuilt, reinstalled, retested: the exact same directory import then succeeded end-to-end.

commands.command: REAL DEFECT #2 (found and fixed, privacy audit): unredacted content:// URI in error logs
commands.summary: Defect #1's own exception message embedded the full content:// tree URI (revealing the picked tree's on-device path structure: 'Download/repo-dir-fixture'), and resolveError's original Logger.error(tag, message, throwable) call would have re-embedded that same URI via the Throwable's own stack-trace dump regardless of any redaction applied to the message string alongside it. Fixed by (a) redacting any content://... substring in the logged message text via a regex, and (b) no longer passing the raw Throwable to Logger.error (passing null instead, so Android's Log.e does not additionally dump the throwable's own unredacted message/stack trace) -- the exception class name and reason code remain logged for diagnosability. Verified via a full logcat buffer search after the runtime session: zero content:// occurrences originating from this app's own log tags (SafAcquisitionPlugin/Tauri).

commands.command: Tooling artifacts encountered and resolved (not product defects)
commands.summary: This session's own adb/shell tooling produced two red herrings, recorded for transparency: (1) `adb shell run-as PKG sh -c "multi word command"` silently collapses to `sh -c <firstWord>` when adb re-joins argv with spaces across the local/remote boundary, discarding the rest as unused positional parameters -- worked around by passing the entire remote command as one already-quoted string to `adb shell`. (2) `/data/data/<pkg>/files/repositories` does not exist; this app's own WorkspaceManager root is `app_data_dir().join("repositories")` and Tauri's Android app_data_dir() resolves to the bare dataDir root (`/data/user/0/<pkg>`), not `dataDir/files` (that `files/` prefix is specific to WI060's now-superseded debug-validation path, not this checkpoint's production path) -- resolved by using the canonical `/data/user/0/<pkg>/repositories` path throughout. Neither issue involved product code.
